segments.name: Financial Services
segments.description: Provides end-to-end business solutions and technology services to enterprises in financial services and insurance, including the Finacle operating segment.
segments.evidence: The Financial Services reportable segments has been aggregated to include the Financial Services operating segment and Finacle operating segment because of the similarity of the economic characteristics.

segments.name: Manufacturing
segments.description: Serves manufacturing enterprises with end-to-end business solutions and technology services to enhance their business performance.
segments.evidence: Business segments of the Group are primarily enterprises in Financial Services and Insurance, enterprises in Manufacturing, enterprises in Retail, Consumer Packaged Goods and Logistics, enterprises in the Energy, Utilities, Resources and Services, enterprises in Communication, Telecom OEM and Media, enterprises in Hi-Tech, enterprises in Life Sciences and Healthcare and all other segments.
